project.name: FreshFind
project.tagline: Discover fresh local produce and farmers markets near you.

markets.name: Empress Market
markets.address: Preedy St, Saddar Town, Karachi, Sindh 74400
markets.schedule: Sat–Sun: 8 AM–2 PM, Wed: 8 AM–1 PM
markets.description: Historic Victorian-era market square established in 1889, hosting dozens of regional farmers offering organic fruits, native herbs, and farm-fresh vegetables.

markets.name: Riverside Farmers Market
markets.description: Coastal open-air morning pavilion specializing in artisanal cheeses, certified organic greens, heirloom tomatoes, and crisp seasonal orchard fruits.

markets.name: Sunrise Farmers Market
markets.schedule: Sat–Sun: 7 AM–1 PM, Tue: 7 AM–11 AM
markets.description: Vibrant community morning market featuring pesticide-free mountain berries, hydroponic salad herbs, crisp root carrots, and handcrafted cottage cheeses.

markets.name: Green Valley Organic Market
markets.address: Block H, Main Shahrah-e-Sher Shah Suri, North Nazimabad, Karachi
markets.description: Lush botanical agro-fair linking suburban consumers with rural smallholder farms for fresh dairy milk, pure cheeses, fragrant mint, and seasonal greens.

markets.name: Gulshan Agro Fresh Market
markets.schedule: Mon, Wed, Fri, Sat: 9 AM–3 PM
markets.description: Busy agricultural depot popular among university families, presenting a huge variety of field-picked vine tomatoes, fresh milk, and aromatic culinary herbs.

markets.name: Bahria Community Harvest
markets.address: Malir River Green Belt & Farm Road, Karachi
markets.description: Direct-from-grower cooperative showcasing fresh strawberries, artisan cheese, organic milk, spinach, and sweet Italian basil directly from nearby river farms.

products.name: Organic Honeycrisp Apples
products.description: Crispy, naturally sweet organic apples packed with dietary fiber, vitamin C, and antioxidants from orchard harvests.
products.storageTip: Store in a cool dry crisper drawer to maintain snap for up to 3 weeks.

products.name: Vine-Ripened Heirloom Tomatoes
products.description: Sweet, juicy field tomatoes bursting with savory flavor, rich in natural lycopene and vitamin A.
products.storageTip: Keep at room temperature away from direct sunlight for the best aroma and texture.

products.name: Crisp Farm Baby Spinach
products.description: Tender, vibrant dark-green leaves carefully harvested in early dawn, loaded with iron, lutein, and folate.
products.storageTip: Wrap in a dry paper towel and refrigerate in an airtight container to keep crisp.

products.name: Sweet Crunchy Root Carrots
products.description: Earthy, firm carrots harvested with greens intact, naturally sweet and packed with eyesight-boosting beta-carotene.
products.storageTip: Trim green tops before storing in the vegetable drawer to retain natural sweetness.

products.name: Fresh Field Strawberries
products.description: Aromatic ruby-red berries picked fresh at morning dew, packed with polyphenols, manganese, and vitamin C.
products.storageTip: Do not wash until immediately before serving; store chilled in original breathable box.

products.name: Aromatic Sweet Basil
products.description: Fragrant sweet Italian and Mediterranean basil leaves, rich in essential oils, ideal for pestos, salads, and pasta.
products.storageTip: Treat like freshly cut flowers in a cup of water at room temperature.

products.name: Invigorating Garden Mint
products.description: Crisp and cooling spearmint and peppermint shoots, perfect for revitalizing teas, lemonades, chutneys, and garnishes.
products.storageTip: Wrap loosely in damp kitchen cloth and refrigerate.

products.name: Grass-Fed Farm Whole Milk
products.description: Wholesome, pure unpasteurized morning farm milk with thick golden cream layer, free from synthetic hormones or additives.
products.storageTip: Store between 2°C and 4°C in the coldest middle section of the refrigerator.

products.name: Artisanal Farmhouse Cheese
products.description: Aged natural farmhouse cheese handmade in small wheels using traditional rennet and grass-fed dairy cow milk.
products.storageTip: Wrap in parchment paper or cheese paper rather than plastic wrap to let it breathe.

faq.a: FreshFind is a client-side web platform that connects local communities with fresh farmers markets, seasonal produce guides, and direct market schedules in Karachi.
Yes! All schedules are pre-verified weekly schedules reflecting morning farm operating hours and vendor availability.

faq.q: How can I bookmark a market or product?
faq.a: Click the heart or 'Save Bookmark' button on any market card or product card. You can view, add personal notes, export, and share your bookmarks from the Bookmarks tab.
